changelog: - **Two more node icons: a rain cloud and the recycling mark.** The Icon field in the Inspector now offers a rain cloud, listed after the cloud under Nature and basics, and recycling, listed last under Industry and life. They behave exactly like the first fourteen: a drawing before the node's name that changes nothing a run computes, saved in the file and in share links under the same revision note, named in all 18 languages. A file that uses one of them opens in an older version with that mark left out and the node kept.
